integrity: The Markov generator and stationary covariance are independently reconstructed, the central spectral comparison has an exact rational identity, and the thresholds and frequency exponents follow by algebra and local perturbation. Included standalone verification program replays 783 deterministic checks. No independent scientific audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the exact stationary power spectrum for a homogeneous four-state cycle independently combined with a symmetric two-state gate. It does not cover coupled switching, nonuniform rates or alternative observables. Numerical verification samples do not establish global uniqueness or asymptotic exponents; these are proved analytically. Publication-priority comparison against all generalized rational-spectrum results is not complete.
title: A tricritical spectral onset in an eight-state phosphorylation oscillator
